CENS 104.title: Canadian Monuments to Central and Eastern European History
CENS 104.description: Structural monuments and sites dedicated to the history and immigration from Central and Eastern Europe in Canada and their influence on Canadian cultures of remembrance.

CENS 201.title: Contrasts and Conflicts: The Cultures of Central, Eastern and Northern Europe (in English)
CENS 201.description: An introduction to the cultural history of the peoples of Central, Eastern and Northern Europe as reflected in their literature, art and music.

CENS 202.title: Great Works of Literature from Central, Eastern and Northern Europe (in English).
CENS 202.description: Major works of Central, Eastern and Northern European literature from the eighteenth century to the present in their European context.

CENS 203.title: Arctic Art and Activism
CENS 203.description: Examination of contemporary political and social conflicts in the arctic and circumpolar north, focusing on ways Indigenous people have used art, performance and activism as a tool for resistance and decolonization.

CENS 299.title: Directed Studies
CENS 299.description: Investigation of readings and research undertaking topics of Modern European Studies, with the agreement and under the supervision of a faculty member with relevant expertise. Restricted to MEST students with approval from the Director of Undergraduate Studies.

CENS 303.title: Representations of the Holocaust: Ghetto
CENS 303.description: The Nazi Ghetto in film and literature from Central, Eastern, and Northern European Countries.

CENS 304.title: Representations of the Holocaust: Auschwitz
CENS 304.description: Concentration camps in art, film and literature from Central, Eastern and Northern European countries.

CENS 307.title: Witches: Myth and Reality
CENS 307.description: Examination of the cultural, social, and historical construction of the witch in central and northern Europe with comparisons to recent history, current events, and popular culture.

CENS 308.title: Comics and Graphic Novels in Central, Eastern and Northern Europe
CENS 308.description: Political, cultural and social themes in European comics and graphic media.

CENS 315.title: Becoming Multilingual: Experience, Aesthetics, Community
CENS 315.description: Practice, theory, history, aesthetics, and poetics of the multilingual experience in its diverse contexts in Central, Eastern, and Northern Europe.

CENS 319.title: Language, Place and Power

CENS 404.title: Gender and Nation: Women's State in Modern Central, Eastern and Northern European Literatures and Cultures
CENS 404.description: Cultural and social discourses of gender in literary works written in Central, Eastern and Northern Europe roughly between 1850 - 1930.

CENS 405.title: Supernatural Folklore
CENS 405.description: Supernatural folklore and belief situated in Central, Eastern and Northern European cultures, with focus on its role in religion, health, and expressive culture, power structures and Indigenous contexts.

CENS 499.title: Directed Studies
CENS 499.description: Advanced research undertaking topics of Modern European Studies, with the agreement and under the supervision, of a faculty member with relevant expertise. Restricted to MEST students with approval from the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
